##CURRENT_DATE##

##EMPLOYEE_NAME##

##EMPLOYEE_ADDRESS##

 

Dear ##EMPLOYEE_NAME##,

 

We are pleased to inform you that you have been selected for employment with us as ##EMPLOYEE_DESIGNATION##  with ##COMPANY_NAME## (Unit of N-Expert Solutions Private Limited). Your Total emoluments are INR 17,00,000 /- CTC. (Fixed (80%) INR 16,00,000/- Variable (20%) INR 1,00,000 /- based on your individual and company performance in half yearly). You may also be assigned and / or deputed to any other subsidiary/- affiliated companies / Divisions whenever the company may deem fit.

You are expected to join on XXXDATEXXX at 9:30 AM at the following location to complete your joining formalities:

Assotech Business Cresterra, Tower-2 | 9th Floor | Unit No. #901-902, Sector-135, Noida 201305, Uttar Pradesh, India

You may, at the discretion of the Company and in accordance with business requirements, be required to relocate or be deployed to any of the Company’s units, departments, affiliated entities, or to the offices of its customers, whether within India or overseas.

In such an event, your remuneration, benefits, allowances, and other employment terms shall be governed by and aligned with the Company’s applicable policies prevailing at the respective location of assignment.

Any approval for remote or hybrid working arrangements shall be subject to ongoing performance evaluation and business exigencies and shall remain under continuous review. The Company reserves the sole right to modify, suspend, or withdraw such arrangements at any time.

By accepting this offer, you hereby irrevocably consent to the foregoing terms and acknowledge the Company’s right to assign, transfer, or redeploy you as outlined above.

Compensation and Benefits Salary

The detailed break-up of your salary and benefits has been set out in Annexure – I and shall be governed by the Company’s applicable compensation policies.

Health Insurance

The Company shall extend group health insurance coverage to you with an annual coverage of INR 3,00,000/- or 5,00,000/- (Rupees Three or Five Lakhs Only).

Such coverage shall become effective from day 1 and shall be governed by the terms, conditions, and limitations of the Company’s insurance policy in force from time to time.

Notice Period

Post confirmation of your employment, either party may terminate this employment by providing three (3) months’ prior written notice. You shall be required to serve the full notice period unless otherwise waived or reduced at the sole discretion of the Company. During the notice period, you are expected to continue to discharge your duties diligently and complete all handover and exit formalities. Your salary and any other dues payable during the notice period shall be processed and released only upon successful completion of the full notice period and clearance of all exit formalities, and shall form part of the full and final settlement. Failure to serve the stipulated notice period may result in adjustment or forfeiture of dues and withholding of the relieving letter, as per Company policy.

In the event that you fail to serve the stipulated notice period in full and/or fail to duly complete the handover of all Company property, assets, access credentials, and responsibilities to the satisfaction of the Company, no salary, incentives, or other dues shall be payable for the notice period, and no relieving letter, experience certificate, or any other employment-related documents shall be issued by CES Tech. Any amounts otherwise payable to you may be withheld or adjusted against outstanding obligations, losses, or recoveries, in accordance with Company policy and applicable law. The Company reserves the right to take appropriate legal or administrative action for recovery of Company assets and dues, as deemed necessary.

Probation Period

You shall be on probation for a period of six (6) months from the date of commencement of your employment. The probation period may be extended at the sole discretion of the Company. Upon successful completion of the probation period, your employment shall be confirmed in writing on company internal tool.

During the probation period, either party may terminate this employment by providing two (2) months’ written notice. Post confirmation, the notice period shall be three (3) months’ written notice .

Resignation, Cost Recovery & Background Verification

In the event of voluntary resignation:

  • Within six (6) months from the date of joining, you shall be liable to fully reimburse the Company for all costs and expenses incurred on you (excluding earned salary).
  • Between six (6) and twelve (12) months from the date of joining, you shall be liable to reimburse fifty percent (50%) of such costs and expenses (excluding earned salary).

This offer and your continued employment are subject to satisfactory background verification and reference checks. Any misrepresentation, suppression of facts, or adverse findings may result in withdrawal of this offer or compensation.

This offer is subject to your reference check clearance. Your retention in company’s employment will be subject to your continued medical fitness. Company reserves the right to ask you to undergo medical examination as and when considered necessary. 

Working Hours

The work timing are at the sole discretion of the Management and would normally consist of a 200 hours’ work on a month. These are subject to change as per business requirements. Same numbers of work hours are expected even when you are on an assignment abroad, unless communicated otherwise by a ##COMPANY_NAME## entity. The general working hours will be 9:30 A.M. to 6:30 P.M, Monday through Saturday, except second and fourth saturday and sundays. Employees may also be expected to work in shifts based on business requirements.

Paid Leave

Post successful completion of the probation period, you shall be eligible for ten (10) days of Casual Leave and eight (8) days of Sick Leave per calendar year, in accordance with the Company’s leave policy.

Casual Leave and Sick Leave shall not be applicable or permitted during the notice period, and any unutilized leave shall not be encashed or adjusted against the notice period unless expressly approved in writing by the Management, and it will reflect in company internal tool.

Service Commitment / Employee Bond

In consideration of your appointment, access to proprietary information, client exposure, and any training (formal or on-the-job) provided by the Company, you agree to serve CES Tech for a minimum continuous period of twenty-four (24) months from the date of joining of your employment. In the event of voluntary resignation, abandonment of employment, or termination of services attributable to you prior to completion of the said period, you shall be liable to pay the Company a sum of INR 5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakhs Only) as liquidated damages, representing a genuine pre-estimate of costs incurred by the Company. The Company shall be entitled to recover the said amount from any dues payable to you or through other lawful means.

Non-Disclosure

Due to the proprietary nature of our products and services, employee is expected to maintain the highest level of confidentiality and will be required to sign an agreement not to disclose any information with respect to ##COMPANY_NAME##

Business Code of Conduct and Ethics

Employee is expected to maintain the highest level of ethical conduct and are required to sign our Code of Ethical Business Conduct and Conflict of Interest certificate. Any instance of improper conduct including but not limited to misconduct, gross negligence or abandonment of the position to which you have been appointed shall constitute sufficient grounds for immediate termination of your services without any notice.

Information Security

Employee is expected to maintain the confidentiality and integrity of the information assets and comply with the Information Security Policies. Employee is expected to maintain confidentiality of information residing in mobile computing devices such as portable laptops, notebooks, mouse, headphone, pendrive and other equipments provide by company. Employee is responsible for maintaining information security outside the premises of organization and outside the normal working hours.

Notice for Termination

The written notice required for termination of employment will be 1 months’ notice by either party. You would be required to serve the stipulated notice period and early release would be at the sole discretion of the Management. In case you leave your employment without giving requisite notice, no relieving letter will be issued and settlement of dues will be at the sole discretion of the Management. However, under ##COMPANY_NAME## disciplinary procedure your services can be terminated without any notice period.

Service Agreement

Post you are joining, should you accept any specialised training whether in India or abroad, you will be required to commit to serve ##COMPANY_NAME## for a minimum period of 24 months as per the ##COMPANY_NAME## policy or depends on training and certification. You will be required to enter into a Service/ Bond Agreement, as per ##COMPANY_NAME##’ policy on Training, supported with a Guarantee in the form and manner decided by ##COMPANY_NAME## .You are under no obligation to accept any training requiring a commitment to serve ##COMPANY_NAME## on your part .However, once accepted by you, this shall constitute a legally binding contract. Any termination or breach thereof shall be governed by the terms of the applicable Service Agreement, including the penalties stipulated therein. Prior to execution, ##COMPANY_NAME## shall provide you with full clarity and disclosure of the Service Agreement terms.

Exclusive Employment

You agree that, during the tenure of your employment with the Company, you shall not engage in any other employment or association, whether full-time or part-time, including as a director, partner, member, consultant, or employee of any other organization or entity engaged in any business activity, without the prior written consent of ##COMPANY_NAME## . Any such consent, if granted, may be subject to conditions as deemed appropriate by the Company and may be withdrawn at its sole discretion at any time.

Company Policies

You acknowledge and agree to comply with all internal policies, rules, and procedures of the Company, as may be applicable to you from time to time and made available upon joining. These policies govern various human resource, administrative, and operational matters. The Company reserves the right to amend, modify, or withdraw such policies at its absolute discretion.

Rotational and Shift Work

Based on business requirements and the nature of your role, you may be required to work rotational or shift-based schedules, including night shifts. Any such change in shift timing shall be communicated to you in advance. During such assignments, you shall continue to be governed by the Company’s working hours policy. Where applicable and in force, the Company’s night shift allowance policy shall apply.

Entire Agreement

This offer letter constitutes the entire, final, and exclusive agreement between you and the Company with respect to the terms of your employment and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous discussions, representations, promises, or agreements, whether written or oral. This agreement has been entered into without reliance on any representation not expressly set forth herein and may be amended only by a written instrument duly executed by an authorized representative of the Company.

Severability

If any provision of this offer letter is held to be illegal, invalid, or unenforceable under applicable law, such provision shall be deemed severable, and the remaining provisions shall continue to be valid, binding, and enforceable to the fullest extent permitted by law.

This offer/appointment is subject to the condition that you indemnify and also certify that all the information (like educational qualifications, work experience, past salary drawn and all other information) supplied by you to ##COMPANY_NAME## to get an employment with ##COMPANY_NAME##, is accurate and nothing has been given untrue. If it is later found that you had supplied inaccurate/untrue/false information, then ##COMPANY_NAME## reserves the right to terminate your services without any notice and seek appropriate damages or reimbursement of financial expenses incurred towards your training, relocation, any other allowances, etc. This is without prejudice to any other rights which ##COMPANY_NAME## may have against you.

##COMPANY_NAME## reserves the right to change terms and the conditions of your employment and its policies and procedures at any time.

Please sign a duplicate copy of this letter confirming your acceptance of the above terms and conditions of appointment and return it to us for office records.

We are excited about your decision to join the company and wish you a long successful career with ##COMPANY_NAME##.

 

Sincerely,

 

 

Authority Signatory

 

 

#Annexure I

 

 


 

Read and Accepted

 

Dear ##EMPLOYEE_NAME##,

Annexure

Please note that you must submit a copy of your Permanent Account Number (PAN) card on your date of joining at ##COMPANY_NAME##. By acknowledging this document, you undertake that you shall be solely responsible for any consequences arising due to non-submission of your PAN copy and ##COMPANY_NAME## shall not be responsible for the same, in any manner whatsoever.

 

Date:

##EMPLOYEE_NAME##

Read and accepted

Where applicable and in force, the Company’s night shift allowance policy shall apply.

Entire Agreement

We are excited about your decision to join the company and wish you a long successful career with ##COMPANY_NAME##.

 

Sincerely,

In such an event, your remuneration, benefits, allowances, and other employment terms shall be governed by and aligned with the Company’s applicable policies prevailing at the respective location of assignment.

Any approval for remote or hybrid working arrangements shall be subject to ongoing performance evaluation and business exigencies and shall remain under continuous review. The Company reserves the sole right to modify, suspend, or withdraw such arrangements at any time.

By accepting this offer, you hereby irrevocably consent to the foregoing terms and acknowledge the Company’s right to assign, transfer, or redeploy you as outlined above.

Compensation and Benefits Salary

The detailed break-up of your salary and benefits has been set out in Annexure – I and shall be governed by the Company’s applicable compensation policies.

Health Insurance

The Company shall extend group health insurance coverage to you with an annual coverage of INR 3,00,000/- or 5,00,000/- (Rupees Three or Five Lakhs Only).

Such coverage shall become effective from day 1 and shall be governed by the terms, conditions, and limitations of the Company’s insurance policy in force from time to time.

Notice Period

Post confirmation of your employment, either party may terminate this employment by providing three (3) months’ prior written notice. You shall be required to serve the full notice period unless otherwise waived or reduced at the sole discretion of the Company. During the notice period, you are expected to continue to discharge your duties diligently and complete all handover and exit formalities. Your salary and any other dues payable during the notice period shall be processed and released only upon successful completion of the full notice period and clearance of all exit formalities, and shall form part of the full and final settlement. In the event that you fail to serve the stipulated notice period in full and/or fail to duly complete the handover of all Company property, assets, access credentials, and responsibilities to the satisfaction of the Company, no salary, incentives, or other dues shall be payable for the notice period, and no relieving letter, experience certificate, or any other employment-related documents shall be issued by CES Tech. Any amounts otherwise payable to you may be withheld or adjusted against outstanding obligations, losses, or recoveries, in accordance with Company policy and applicable law. The Company reserves the right to take appropriate legal or administrative action for recovery of Company assets and dues, as deemed necessary.

  • Within six (6) months from the date of joining, you shall be liable to fully reimburse the Company for all costs and expenses incurred on you (excluding earned salary).

Working Hours

Same numbers of work hours are expected even when you are on an assignment abroad, unless communicated otherwise by a ##COMPANY_NAME## entity. Service Commitment / Employee Bond

Information Security

Employee is expected to maintain the confidentiality and integrity of the information assets and comply with the Information Security Policies. Employee is expected to maintain confidentiality of information residing in mobile computing devices such as portable laptops, notebooks, mouse, headphone, pendrive and other equipments provide by company. Employee is responsible for maintaining information security outside the premises of organization and outside the normal working hours.

You would be required to serve the stipulated notice period and early release would be at the sole discretion of the Management. In case you leave your employment without giving requisite notice, no relieving letter will be issued and settlement of dues will be at the sole discretion of the Management. However, under ##COMPANY_NAME## disciplinary procedure your services can be terminated without any notice period.

Post you are joining, should you accept any specialised training whether in India or abroad, you will be required to commit to serve ##COMPANY_NAME## for a minimum period of 24 months as per the ##COMPANY_NAME## policy or depends on training and certification. You will be required to enter into a Service/ Bond Agreement, as per ##COMPANY_NAME##’ policy on Training, supported with a Guarantee in the form and manner decided by ##COMPANY_NAME## .You are under no obligation to accept any training requiring a commitment to serve ##COMPANY_NAME## on your part .However, once accepted by you, this shall constitute a legally binding contract. Prior to execution, ##COMPANY_NAME## shall provide you with full clarity and disclosure of the Service Agreement terms.

Exclusive Employment

You agree that, during the tenure of your employment with the Company, you shall not engage in any other employment or association, whether full-time or part-time, including as a director, partner, member, consultant, or employee of any other organization or entity engaged in any business activity, without the prior written consent of ##COMPANY_NAME## . You acknowledge and agree to comply with all internal policies, rules, and procedures of the Company, as may be applicable to you from time to time and made available upon joining. Any such change in shift timing shall be communicated to you in advance. During such assignments, you shall continue to be governed by the Company’s working hours policy. Where applicable and in force, the Company’s night shift allowance policy shall apply.

Entire Agreement

This offer letter constitutes the entire, final, and exclusive agreement between you and the Company with respect to the terms of your employment and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous discussions, representations, promises, or agreements, whether written or oral. This agreement has been entered into without reliance on any representation not expressly set forth herein and may be amended only by a written instrument duly executed by an authorized representative of the Company.

Severability

Sincerely,

##CURRENT_DATE##

##EMPLOYEE_NAME##

##EMPLOYEE_ADDRESS##

 

Dear ##EMPLOYEE_NAME##,

 

We are pleased to inform you that you have been selected for employment with us as ##EMPLOYEE_DESIGNATION##  with ##COMPANY_NAME## (Unit of N-Expert Solutions Private Limited). Your Total emoluments are INR 17,00,000 /- CTC. (Fixed (80%) INR 16,00,000/- Variable (20%) INR 1,00,000 /- based on your individual and company performance in half yearly). You may also be assigned and / or deputed to any other subsidiary/- affiliated companies / Divisions whenever the company may deem fit.

You are expected to join on XXXDATEXXX at 9:30 AM at the following location to complete your joining formalities:

Assotech Business Cresterra, Tower-2 | 9th Floor | Unit No. #901-902, Sector-135, Noida 201305, Uttar Pradesh, India

You may, at the discretion of the Company and in accordance with business requirements, be required to relocate or be deployed to any of the Company’s units, departments, affiliated entities, or to the offices of its customers, whether within India or overseas.

In such an event, your remuneration, benefits, allowances, and other employment terms shall be governed by and aligned with the Company’s applicable policies prevailing at the respective location of assignment.

Any approval for remote or hybrid working arrangements shall be subject to ongoing performance evaluation and business exigencies and shall remain under continuous review. The Company reserves the sole right to modify, suspend, or withdraw such arrangements at any time.

By accepting this offer, you hereby irrevocably consent to the foregoing terms and acknowledge the Company’s right to assign, transfer, or redeploy you as outlined above.

Compensation and Benefits Salary

The detailed break-up of your salary and benefits has been set out in Annexure – I and shall be governed by the Company’s applicable compensation policies.

Health Insurance

The Company shall extend group health insurance coverage to you with an annual coverage of INR 3,00,000/- or 5,00,000/- (Rupees Three or Five Lakhs Only).

Such coverage shall become effective from day 1 and shall be governed by the terms, conditions, and limitations of the Company’s insurance policy in force from time to time.

Notice Period

Post confirmation of your employment, either party may terminate this employment by providing three (3) months’ prior written notice. You shall be required to serve the full notice period unless otherwise waived or reduced at the sole discretion of the Company. During the notice period, you are expected to continue to discharge your duties diligently and complete all handover and exit formalities. Your salary and any other dues payable during the notice period shall be processed and released only upon successful completion of the full notice period and clearance of all exit formalities, and shall form part of the full and final settlement. Failure to serve the stipulated notice period may result in adjustment or forfeiture of dues and withholding of the relieving letter, as per Company policy.

In the event that you fail to serve the stipulated notice period in full and/or fail to duly complete the handover of all Company property, assets, access credentials, and responsibilities to the satisfaction of the Company, no salary, incentives, or other dues shall be payable for the notice period, and no relieving letter, experience certificate, or any other employment-related documents shall be issued by CES Tech. Any amounts otherwise payable to you may be withheld or adjusted against outstanding obligations, losses, or recoveries, in accordance with Company policy and applicable law. The Company reserves the right to take appropriate legal or administrative action for recovery of Company assets and dues, as deemed necessary.

Probation Period

You shall be on probation for a period of six (6) months from the date of commencement of your employment. The probation period may be extended at the sole discretion of the Company. Upon successful completion of the probation period, your employment shall be confirmed in writing on company internal tool.

During the probation period, either party may terminate this employment by providing two (2) months’ written notice. Post confirmation, the notice period shall be three (3) months’ written notice .

Resignation, Cost Recovery & Background Verification

In the event of voluntary resignation:

  • Within six (6) months from the date of joining, you shall be liable to fully reimburse the Company for all costs and expenses incurred on you (excluding earned salary).
  • Between six (6) and twelve (12) months from the date of joining, you shall be liable to reimburse fifty percent (50%) of such costs and expenses (excluding earned salary).

This offer and your continued employment are subject to satisfactory background verification and reference checks. Any misrepresentation, suppression of facts, or adverse findings may result in withdrawal of this offer or compensation.

This offer is subject to your reference check clearance. Your retention in company’s employment will be subject to your continued medical fitness. Company reserves the right to ask you to undergo medical examination as and when considered necessary. 

Working Hours

The work timing are at the sole discretion of the Management and would normally consist of a 200 hours’ work on a month. These are subject to change as per business requirements. Same numbers of work hours are expected even when you are on an assignment abroad, unless communicated otherwise by a ##COMPANY_NAME## entity. The general working hours will be 9:30 A.M. to 6:30 P.M, Monday through Saturday, except second and fourth saturday and sundays. Employees may also be expected to work in shifts based on business requirements.

Paid Leave

Post successful completion of the probation period, you shall be eligible for ten (10) days of Casual Leave and eight (8) days of Sick Leave per calendar year, in accordance with the Company’s leave policy.

Casual Leave and Sick Leave shall not be applicable or permitted during the notice period, and any unutilized leave shall not be encashed or adjusted against the notice period unless expressly approved in writing by the Management, and it will reflect in company internal tool.

Service Commitment / Employee Bond

In consideration of your appointment, access to proprietary information, client exposure, and any training (formal or on-the-job) provided by the Company, you agree to serve CES Tech for a minimum continuous period of twenty-four (24) months from the date of joining of your employment. In the event of voluntary resignation, abandonment of employment, or termination of services attributable to you prior to completion of the said period, you shall be liable to pay the Company a sum of INR 5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakhs Only) as liquidated damages, representing a genuine pre-estimate of costs incurred by the Company. The Company shall be entitled to recover the said amount from any dues payable to you or through other lawful means.

Non-Disclosure

Due to the proprietary nature of our products and services, employee is expected to maintain the highest level of confidentiality and will be required to sign an agreement not to disclose any information with respect to ##COMPANY_NAME##

Business Code of Conduct and Ethics

Employee is expected to maintain the highest level of ethical conduct and are required to sign our Code of Ethical Business Conduct and Conflict of Interest certificate. Any instance of improper conduct including but not limited to misconduct, gross negligence or abandonment of the position to which you have been appointed shall constitute sufficient grounds for immediate termination of your services without any notice.

Information Security

Employee is expected to maintain the confidentiality and integrity of the information assets and comply with the Information Security Policies. Employee is expected to maintain confidentiality of information residing in mobile computing devices such as portable laptops, notebooks, mouse, headphone, pendrive and other equipments provide by company. Employee is responsible for maintaining information security outside the premises of organization and outside the normal working hours.

Notice for Termination

The written notice required for termination of employment will be 1 months’ notice by either party. You would be required to serve the stipulated notice period and early release would be at the sole discretion of the Management. In case you leave your employment without giving requisite notice, no relieving letter will be issued and settlement of dues will be at the sole discretion of the Management. However, under ##COMPANY_NAME## disciplinary procedure your services can be terminated without any notice period.

Service Agreement

Post you are joining, should you accept any specialised training whether in India or abroad, you will be required to commit to serve ##COMPANY_NAME## for a minimum period of 24 months as per the ##COMPANY_NAME## policy or depends on training and certification. You will be required to enter into a Service/ Bond Agreement, as per ##COMPANY_NAME##’ policy on Training, supported with a Guarantee in the form and manner decided by ##COMPANY_NAME## .You are under no obligation to accept any training requiring a commitment to serve ##COMPANY_NAME## on your part .However, once accepted by you, this shall constitute a legally binding contract. Any termination or breach thereof shall be governed by the terms of the applicable Service Agreement, including the penalties stipulated therein. Prior to execution, ##COMPANY_NAME## shall provide you with full clarity and disclosure of the Service Agreement terms.

Exclusive Employment

You agree that, during the tenure of your employment with the Company, you shall not engage in any other employment or association, whether full-time or part-time, including as a director, partner, member, consultant, or employee of any other organization or entity engaged in any business activity, without the prior written consent of ##COMPANY_NAME## . Any such consent, if granted, may be subject to conditions as deemed appropriate by the Company and may be withdrawn at its sole discretion at any time.

Company Policies

You acknowledge and agree to comply with all internal policies, rules, and procedures of the Company, as may be applicable to you from time to time and made available upon joining. These policies govern various human resource, administrative, and operational matters. The Company reserves the right to amend, modify, or withdraw such policies at its absolute discretion.

Rotational and Shift Work

Based on business requirements and the nature of your role, you may be required to work rotational or shift-based schedules, including night shifts. Any such change in shift timing shall be communicated to you in advance. During such assignments, you shall continue to be governed by the Company’s working hours policy. Where applicable and in force, the Company’s night shift allowance policy shall apply.

Entire Agreement

This offer letter constitutes the entire, final, and exclusive agreement between you and the Company with respect to the terms of your employment and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous discussions, representations, promises, or agreements, whether written or oral. This agreement has been entered into without reliance on any representation not expressly set forth herein and may be amended only by a written instrument duly executed by an authorized representative of the Company.

Severability

If any provision of this offer letter is held to be illegal, invalid, or unenforceable under applicable law, such provision shall be deemed severable, and the remaining provisions shall continue to be valid, binding, and enforceable to the fullest extent permitted by law.

This offer/appointment is subject to the condition that you indemnify and also certify that all the information (like educational qualifications, work experience, past salary drawn and all other information) supplied by you to ##COMPANY_NAME## to get an employment with ##COMPANY_NAME##, is accurate and nothing has been given untrue. If it is later found that you had supplied inaccurate/untrue/false information, then ##COMPANY_NAME## reserves the right to terminate your services without any notice and seek appropriate damages or reimbursement of financial expenses incurred towards your training, relocation, any other allowances, etc. This is without prejudice to any other rights which ##COMPANY_NAME## may have against you.

##COMPANY_NAME## reserves the right to change terms and the conditions of your employment and its policies and procedures at any time.

Please sign a duplicate copy of this letter confirming your acceptance of the above terms and conditions of appointment and return it to us for office records.

We are excited about your decision to join the company and wish you a long successful career with ##COMPANY_NAME##.

 

Sincerely,

 

 

Authority Signatory

 

 

#Annexure I

 

 


 

Read and Accepted

 

Dear ##EMPLOYEE_NAME##,

Annexure

Please note that you must submit a copy of your Permanent Account Number (PAN) card on your date of joining at ##COMPANY_NAME##. By acknowledging this document, you undertake that you shall be solely responsible for any consequences arising due to non-submission of your PAN copy and ##COMPANY_NAME## shall not be responsible for the same, in any manner whatsoever.

 

Date:

Notice Period

Post confirmation of your employment, either party may terminate this employment by providing three (3) months’ prior written notice. You shall be required to serve the full notice period unless otherwise waived or reduced at the sole discretion of the Company. During the notice period, you are expected to continue to discharge your duties diligently and complete all handover and exit formalities. Your salary and any other dues payable during the notice period shall be processed and released only upon successful completion of the full notice period and clearance of all exit formalities, and shall form part of the full and final settlement. Failure to serve the stipulated notice period may result in adjustment or forfeiture of dues and withholding of the relieving letter, as per Company policy.

In the event that you fail to serve the stipulated notice period in full and/or fail to duly complete the handover of all Company property, assets, access credentials, and responsibilities to the satisfaction of the Company, no salary, incentives, or other dues shall be payable for the notice period, and no relieving letter, experience certificate, or any other employment-related documents shall be issued by CES Tech. Any amounts otherwise payable to you may be withheld or adjusted against outstanding obligations, losses, or recoveries, in accordance with Company policy and applicable law. The Company reserves the right to take appropriate legal or administrative action for recovery of Company assets and dues, as deemed necessary.

Probation Period

You shall be on probation for a period of six (6) months from the date of commencement of your employment. The probation period may be extended at the sole discretion of the Company. Upon successful completion of the probation period, your employment shall be confirmed in writing on company internal tool.

During the probation period, either party may terminate this employment by providing two (2) months’ written notice. Post confirmation, the notice period shall be three (3) months’ written notice .

  • Within six (6) months from the date of joining, you shall be liable to fully reimburse the Company for all costs and expenses incurred on you (excluding earned salary).
  • Between six (6) and twelve (12) months from the date of joining, you shall be liable to reimburse fifty percent (50%) of such costs and expenses (excluding earned salary).

This offer and your continued employment are subject to satisfactory background verification and reference checks. Any misrepresentation, suppression of facts, or adverse findings may result in withdrawal of this offer or compensation.

This offer is subject to your reference check clearance. Your retention in company’s employment will be subject to your continued medical fitness. Company reserves the right to ask you to undergo medical examination as and when considered necessary. 

Working Hours

The work timing are at the sole discretion of the Management and would normally consist of a 200 hours’ work on a month. These are subject to change as per business requirements. Same numbers of work hours are expected even when you are on an assignment abroad, unless communicated otherwise by a ##COMPANY_NAME## entity. The general working hours will be 9:30 A.M. to 6:30 P.M, Monday through Saturday, except second and fourth saturday and sundays. Employees may also be expected to work in shifts based on business requirements.

Paid Leave

Service Commitment / Employee Bond

In the event of voluntary resignation, abandonment of employment, or termination of services attributable to you prior to completion of the said period, you shall be liable to pay the Company a sum of INR 5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakhs Only) as liquidated damages, representing a genuine pre-estimate of costs incurred by the Company. The Company shall be entitled to recover the said amount from any dues payable to you or through other lawful means.

Non-Disclosure

Any instance of improper conduct including but not limited to misconduct, gross negligence or abandonment of the position to which you have been appointed shall constitute sufficient grounds for immediate termination of your services without any notice.

Information Security

Employee is expected to maintain the confidentiality and integrity of the information assets and comply with the Information Security Policies. Any termination or breach thereof shall be governed by the terms of the applicable Service Agreement, including the penalties stipulated therein. Prior to execution, ##COMPANY_NAME## shall provide you with full clarity and disclosure of the Service Agreement terms.

You agree that, during the tenure of your employment with the Company, you shall not engage in any other employment or association, whether full-time or part-time, including as a director, partner, member, consultant, or employee of any other organization or entity engaged in any business activity, without the prior written consent of ##COMPANY_NAME## . Any such consent, if granted, may be subject to conditions as deemed appropriate by the Company and may be withdrawn at its sole discretion at any time.

Company Policies

You acknowledge and agree to comply with all internal policies, rules, and procedures of the Company, as may be applicable to you from time to time and made available upon joining. These policies govern various human resource, administrative, and operational matters. The Company reserves the right to amend, modify, or withdraw such policies at its absolute discretion.

Rotational and Shift Work

Based on business requirements and the nature of your role, you may be required to work rotational or shift-based schedules, including night shifts. Any such change in shift timing shall be communicated to you in advance. During such assignments, you shall continue to be governed by the Company’s working hours policy. Where applicable and in force, the Company’s night shift allowance policy shall apply.

Entire Agreement

This offer letter constitutes the entire, final, and exclusive agreement between you and the Company with respect to the terms of your employment and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous discussions, representations, promises, or agreements, whether written or oral. This agreement has been entered into without reliance on any representation not expressly set forth herein and may be amended only by a written instrument duly executed by an authorized representative of the Company.

Severability

If any provision of this offer letter is held to be illegal, invalid, or unenforceable under applicable law, such provision shall be deemed severable, and the remaining provisions shall continue to be valid, binding, and enforceable to the fullest extent permitted by law.

This offer/appointment is subject to the condition that you indemnify and also certify that all the information (like educational qualifications, work experience, past salary drawn and all other information) supplied by you to ##COMPANY_NAME## to get an employment with ##COMPANY_NAME##, is accurate and nothing has been given untrue. ##COMPANY_NAME## reserves the right to change terms and the conditions of your employment and its policies and procedures at any time.

Please sign a duplicate copy of this letter confirming your acceptance of the above terms and conditions of appointment and return it to us for office records.

We are excited about your decision to join the company and wish you a long successful career with ##COMPANY_NAME##.

 

Sincerely,

Any such consent, if granted, may be subject to conditions as deemed appropriate by the Company and may be withdrawn at its sole discretion at any time.

Company Policies

You acknowledge and agree to comply with all internal policies, rules, and procedures of the Company, as may be applicable to you from time to time and made available upon joining. These policies govern various human resource, administrative, and operational matters. The Company reserves the right to amend, modify, or withdraw such policies at its absolute discretion.

Rotational and Shift Work

Based on business requirements and the nature of your role, you may be required to work rotational or shift-based schedules, including night shifts. Any such change in shift timing shall be communicated to you in advance. During such assignments, you shall continue to be governed by the Company’s working hours policy. Where applicable and in force, the Company’s night shift allowance policy shall apply.

This offer letter constitutes the entire, final, and exclusive agreement between you and the Company with respect to the terms of your employment and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous discussions, representations, promises, or agreements, whether written or oral. This agreement has been entered into without reliance on any representation not expressly set forth herein and may be amended only by a written instrument duly executed by an authorized representative of the Company.

Severability

If any provision of this offer letter is held to be illegal, invalid, or unenforceable under applicable law, such provision shall be deemed severable, and the remaining provisions shall continue to be valid, binding, and enforceable to the fullest extent permitted by law.

letters.description:
06-01-25

##EMPLOYEE_NAME##

##EMPLOYEE_ADDRESS##

 

Dear ##EMPLOYEE_NAME##,

 

We are pleased to inform you that you have been selected for employment with us as ##EMPLOYEE_DESIGNATION##  with ##COMPANY_NAME## (Unit of N-Expert Solutions Private Limited). Your Total emoluments are INR 3,36,000 /- CTC. based on your individual and company performance in half yearly). You may also be assigned and / or deputed to any other subsidiary/- affiliated companies / Divisions whenever the company may deem fit.

You are expected to join on 06-01-25 at 9:30 AM at the following location to complete your joining formalities:

Assotech Business Cresterra, Tower-2 | 9th Floor | Unit No. #901-902, Sector-135, Noida 201305, Uttar Pradesh, India

You may, at the discretion of the Company and in accordance with business requirements, be required to relocate or be deployed to any of the Company’s units, departments, affiliated entities, or to the offices of its customers, whether within India or overseas.

In such an event, your remuneration, benefits, allowances, and other employment terms shall be governed by and aligned with the Company’s applicable policies prevailing at the respective location of assignment.

Any approval for remote or hybrid working arrangements shall be subject to ongoing performance evaluation and business exigencies and shall remain under continuous review. The Company reserves the sole right to modify, suspend, or withdraw such arrangements at any time.

By accepting this offer, you hereby irrevocably consent to the foregoing terms and acknowledge the Company’s right to assign, transfer, or redeploy you as outlined above.

Compensation and Benefits Salary

The detailed break-up of your salary and benefits has been set out in Annexure – I and shall be governed by the Company’s applicable compensation policies.

Health Insurance

The Company shall extend group health insurance coverage to you with an annual coverage of INR 3,00,000/- or 5,00,000/- (Rupees Three or Five Lakhs Only).

Such coverage shall become effective from day 1 and shall be governed by the terms, conditions, and limitations of the Company’s insurance policy in force from time to time.

Notice Period

Post confirmation of your employment, either party may terminate this employment by providing three (3) months’ prior written notice. You shall be required to serve the full notice period unless otherwise waived or reduced at the sole discretion of the Company. During the notice period, you are expected to continue to discharge your duties diligently and complete all handover and exit formalities. Your salary and any other dues payable during the notice period shall be processed and released only upon successful completion of the full notice period and clearance of all exit formalities, and shall form part of the full and final settlement. Failure to serve the stipulated notice period may result in adjustment or forfeiture of dues and withholding of the relieving letter, as per Company policy.

In the event that you fail to serve the stipulated notice period in full and/or fail to duly complete the handover of all Company property, assets, access credentials, and responsibilities to the satisfaction of the Company, no salary, incentives, or other dues shall be payable for the notice period, and no relieving letter, experience certificate, or any other employment-related documents shall be issued by CES Tech. Any amounts otherwise payable to you may be withheld or adjusted against outstanding obligations, losses, or recoveries, in accordance with Company policy and applicable law. The Company reserves the right to take appropriate legal or administrative action for recovery of Company assets and dues, as deemed necessary.

Probation Period

You shall be on probation for a period of six (6) months from the date of commencement of your employment. The probation period may be extended at the sole discretion of the Company. Upon successful completion of the probation period, your employment shall be confirmed in writing on company internal tool.

During the probation period, either party may terminate this employment by providing two (2) months’ written notice. Post confirmation, the notice period shall be three (3) months’ written notice .

Resignation, Cost Recovery & Background Verification

In the event of voluntary resignation:

  • Within six (6) months from the date of joining, you shall be liable to fully reimburse the Company for all costs and expenses incurred on you (excluding earned salary).
  • Between six (6) and twelve (12) months from the date of joining, you shall be liable to reimburse fifty percent (50%) of such costs and expenses (excluding earned salary).

This offer and your continued employment are subject to satisfactory background verification and reference checks. Any misrepresentation, suppression of facts, or adverse findings may result in withdrawal of this offer or compensation.

This offer is subject to your reference check clearance. Your retention in company’s employment will be subject to your continued medical fitness. Company reserves the right to ask you to undergo medical examination as and when considered necessary. 

Working Hours

The work timing are at the sole discretion of the Management and would normally consist of a 200 hours’ work on a month. These are subject to change as per business requirements. Same numbers of work hours are expected even when you are on an assignment abroad, unless communicated otherwise by a ##COMPANY_NAME## entity. The general working hours will be 9:30 A.M. to 6:30 P.M, Monday through Saturday, except second and fourth saturday and sundays. Employees may also be expected to work in shifts based on business requirements.

Paid Leave

Post successful completion of the probation period, you shall be eligible for ten (10) days of Casual Leave and eight (8) days of Sick Leave per calendar year, in accordance with the Company’s leave policy.

Casual Leave and Sick Leave shall not be applicable or permitted during the notice period, and any unutilized leave shall not be encashed or adjusted against the notice period unless expressly approved in writing by the Management, and it will reflect in company internal tool.

Service Commitment / Employee Bond

In consideration of your appointment, access to proprietary information, client exposure, and any training (formal or on-the-job) provided by the Company, you agree to serve CES Tech for a minimum continuous period of twenty-four (24) months from the date of joining of your employment. In the event of voluntary resignation, abandonment of employment, or termination of services attributable to you prior to completion of the said period, you shall be liable to pay the Company a sum of INR 5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakhs Only) as liquidated damages, representing a genuine pre-estimate of costs incurred by the Company. The Company shall be entitled to recover the said amount from any dues payable to you or through other lawful means.

Non-Disclosure

Due to the proprietary nature of our products and services, employee is expected to maintain the highest level of confidentiality and will be required to sign an agreement not to disclose any information with respect to ##COMPANY_NAME##

Business Code of Conduct and Ethics

Employee is expected to maintain the highest level of ethical conduct and are required to sign our Code of Ethical Business Conduct and Conflict of Interest certificate. Any instance of improper conduct including but not limited to misconduct, gross negligence or abandonment of the position to which you have been appointed shall constitute sufficient grounds for immediate termination of your services without any notice.

Information Security

Employee is expected to maintain the confidentiality and integrity of the information assets and comply with the Information Security Policies. Employee is expected to maintain confidentiality of information residing in mobile computing devices such as portable laptops, notebooks, mouse, headphone, pendrive and other equipments provide by company. Employee is responsible for maintaining information security outside the premises of organization and outside the normal working hours.

Notice for Termination

The written notice required for termination of employment will be 1 months’ notice by either party. You would be required to serve the stipulated notice period and early release would be at the sole discretion of the Management. In case you leave your employment without giving requisite notice, no relieving letter will be issued and settlement of dues will be at the sole discretion of the Management. However, under ##COMPANY_NAME## disciplinary procedure your services can be terminated without any notice period.

Service Agreement

Post you are joining, should you accept any specialised training whether in India or abroad, you will be required to commit to serve ##COMPANY_NAME## for a minimum period of 24 months as per the ##COMPANY_NAME## policy or depends on training and certification. You will be required to enter into a Service/ Bond Agreement, as per ##COMPANY_NAME##’ policy on Training, supported with a Guarantee in the form and manner decided by ##COMPANY_NAME## .You are under no obligation to accept any training requiring a commitment to serve ##COMPANY_NAME## on your part .However, once accepted by you, this shall constitute a legally binding contract. Any termination or breach thereof shall be governed by the terms of the applicable Service Agreement, including the penalties stipulated therein. Prior to execution, ##COMPANY_NAME## shall provide you with full clarity and disclosure of the Service Agreement terms.

Exclusive Employment

##CURRENT_DATE##

##EMPLOYEE_NAME##

##EMPLOYEE_ADDRESS##


Dear ##EMPLOYEE_NAME##,


We are pleased to inform you that you have been selected for employment with us as ##EMPLOYEE_DESIGNATION##  with ##COMPANY_NAME## (Unit of N-Expert Solutions Private Limited). Your Total emoluments are INR 17,00,000/- CTC. (Fixed INR 16,00,000/- Variable INR 1,00,000/- based on your performance in half yearly). You may also be assigned and / or deputed to any other subsidiary/- affiliated companies / Divisions whenever the company may deem fit.

You are expected to join on 15-12-2025 at 9:30 AM at the following location to complete your joining formalities:

Assotech Business Cresterra, Tower-2 | 9th Floor | Unit No. #901-902, Sector-135, Noida 201305, Uttar Pradesh, India

You will be on probation for 6 Months from the date of commencement of your services, which is liable for extension at the sole discretion of the company. On successful completion of the probation period, your services will be confirmed in writing.

Either party can terminate this employment agreement by providing a written notice a payment of basic pay in Lieu of such notice to the other party. The notice period shall be two months during probation period and three thereafter.

In case of voluntary resignation with six months of joining, you will be responsible for full repayment of the expenses as company invested on you except salary. If the resignation is between six to twelve months of joining 50% of the invested expenses will be recovered. This offer is subject to your reference check clearance. Your retention in company’s employment will be recovered.

This offer is subject to your reference check clearance. Your retention in company’s employment will be subject to your continued medical fitness. Company reserves the right to ask you to undergo medical examination as and when considered necessary. 

Any change in the date of joining would be at the sole discretion of ##COMPANY_NAME## .Please confirm via e-mail your exact date of joining at least 5 days in advance.

 Working Hours:

The work timing are at the sole discretion of the Management and would normally consist of a 200 hours’ work on a month. These are subject to change as per business requirements. Same numbers of work hours are expected even when you are on an assignment abroad, unless communicated otherwise by a ##COMPANY_NAME## entity. The general working hours will be 9:30 A.M. to 6:30 P.M, Monday through Saturday, except second and fourth saturday and sundays. Employees may also be expected to work in shifts based on business requirements.

Paid Casual Leave:

The entitlement is for 10 casual leave in a year. Other terms and conditions will be applicable to you as per the prevailing company Polices, applicable after probation period.

﻿Sick Leave:

Employee is provided a total of 8 sick leaves annually to enable proper health attention in case of sickness (subject to submission of valid documents). These leaves are provided at the beginning of each year and are valid for that year only. They cannot be carried over, applicable after probation period.

Non-Disclosure:

Due to the proprietary nature of our products and services, employee is expected to maintain the highest level of confidentiality and will be required to sign an agreement not to disclose any information with respect to ##COMPANY_NAME##

Business Code of Conduct and Ethics:

Employee is expected to maintain the highest level of ethical conduct and are required to sign our Code of Ethical Business Conduct and Conflict of Interest certificate. Any instance of improper conduct including but not limited to misconduct, gross negligence or abandonment of the position to which you have been appointed shall constitute sufficient grounds for immediate termination of your services without any notice or payment in lieu of.

Information Security:

Employee is expected to maintain the confidentiality and integrity of the information assets and comply with the Information Security Policies. Employee is expected to maintain confidentiality of information residing in mobile computing devices such as portable laptops, notebooks, mouse, headphone, pendrive and other equipments provide by company. Employee is responsible for maintaining information security outside the premises of organization and outside the normal working hours.

Notice for termination:

The written notice required for termination of employment will be 1 months’ notice by either party. You would be required to serve the stipulated notice period and early release would be at the sole discretion of the Management. In case you leave your employment without giving requisite notice, no relieving letter will be issued and settlement of dues will be at the sole discretion of the Management. However, under ##COMPANY_NAME## disciplinary procedure your services can be terminated without any notice period.

Service Agreement:

Post you are joining, should you accept any specialised training whether in India or abroad, you will be required to commit to serve ##COMPANY_NAME## for a minimum period of 18 months as per the ##COMPANY_NAME## policy. You will be required to enter into a Service Agreement, as per ##COMPANY_NAME##’ policy on Training, supported with a Guarantee in the form and manner decided by ##COMPANY_NAME## .You are under no obligation to accept any training requiring a commitment to serve ##COMPANY_NAME## on your part .However, once accepted by you, it will be a binding contract.

Joining Requirements:

You are required to contact HR department on the date you report for work as per terms of this letter at 9:30 A.M.

You are required to submit a copy of the following documents for joining:

1. Photocopies of all educational certificates (Class X onwards)

2. Mark sheets I Consolidated mark sheets of all educational qualifications (Class X onwards) one recent passport size photographs

3. Completed service agreement I guarantor's agreement if applicable to you

4. All relevant pages of your Passport, Driving License, Adharcard and PAN card.

5. 6 months Pay-slip of your last organization, Form 16 of the last financial year and Last month bank statement depicting salary credit from your last organization.

6. Please bring originals of all documents which will be returned to you after verification except service agreement which will be retained by ##COMPANY_NAME## (if applicable).

This offer/appointment is subject to the condition that you indemnify and also certify that all the information (like educational qualifications, work experience, past salary drawn and all other information) supplied by you to ##COMPANY_NAME## to get an employment with ##COMPANY_NAME##, is accurate and nothing has been given untrue. If it is later found that you had supplied inaccurate/untrue/false information, then ##COMPANY_NAME## reserves the right to terminate your services without any notice and seek appropriate damages or reimbursement of financial expenses incurred towards your training, relocation, any other allowances, etc. This is without prejudice to any other rights which ##COMPANY_NAME## may have against you.

##COMPANY_NAME## reserves the right to change terms and the conditions of your employment and its policies and procedures at any time.

Please sign a duplicate copy of this letter confirming your acceptance of the above terms and conditions of appointment and return it to us for office records.

We are excited about your decision to join the company and wish you a long successful career with ##COMPANY_NAME##.

Week off:

Second, Fourth Saturday and each Sunday of every month will be off.(only applicable in implementation team)

Condition,

These off’s will be cancelled in case of customer requirements and scheduled activities. and no comp-off available for second and fourth Saturday.

In case you work on Sunday, comp-off can be availed, subject to written approval from reporting manager.

Quarterly Bonus:

  • Based on your performance on every month basis on assigned task (Project,Signoff with client satification) and follow the rules, we rectify your performance on DPR and tracker basis, make sure have clarity on DPR and tracker and we will get on regular basis.

Ethical Practices:

  • Operate ethically and transparently in all business dealings.
  • Avoid misleading or deceptive advertising practices.

Data Privacy:

  • Respect customer privacy and protect their personal information.
  • Adhere to data protection regulations and secure customer data appropriately.

Knowledge and Expertise:

  • Maintain a knowledgeable and well-trained staff.
  • Stay informed about travel trends, destinations, and regulations.

Fair Pricing:

  • Offer competitive and fair pricing for travel services.
  • Avoid price gouging and ensure pricing policies are transparent.

Emergency Preparedness:

  • Have contingency plans in place for emergencies or unexpected situations affecting travelers.
  • Provide assistance and support to traveler's in emergencies.

Compliance and Licensing:

  • Adhere to all relevant laws, regulations, and licensing requirements.
  • Ensure that all necessary permits and licenses are up to date.

Feedback and Improvement:

  • Encourage customer feedback and use it to improve services.
  • Continuously evaluate and enhance service quality.

Environmental and Cultural Awareness:

Promote responsible travel practices that respect local cultures and environments.

CES Tech Company Polices

  • Promote responsible travel practices that respect local cultures and environments.
  • Office timing: "9:30 Am to 6:30 Pm” (6 Days/Week) Monday To Saturday. delay 10 minutes (max. 3 days delay accepted (pre-informed), if delay more and more than 3 days consider as a half day.
  • DPR Sheet (Daily Progress Report) and tracker sheet are mandatory on daily basis, if not follow on regular basis penalty will be INR 5,000/- deduct from your salary and mark as a absent.
  • Salary and attendance work based on bio-metric. and salary date is 10th Every Month.
  • Advance Salary and advance travel, you can claim one time in a month subject to approval.
  • Advance salary eligible after provision period.
  • Work from home allowed subject on approval.
  • Every saturday management team meeting (Agenda :- Work Progress/ Challenges/ Targets/ Planning).
  • One leave and one Half day are allowed in a month no salary deduction after 6 months of joining.
  • During Provision period like in 6 Months from date of joining no leaves and half day allowed) all will be paid.
  • Leaves should be pre- approved on email with approval confirmation.(Paid or Unpaid), without written approval consider absent.
  • Without information absent (WIA) for each day it will be consider 3 days deduct salary based on 3 days.
  • Use always official email Id for any communication and wear always Id card and formals.
  • Work assign complete with deadline/ no excuses acceptable.
  • Maintain office decorum (no personal talk and phone allow in office hours)
  • 30 minutes lunch allow only general time (1:00 to 1:30 Pm / 1:30 Pm To 2:00 Pm)
  • 15 Minutes small break allowed during working hours.
  • consider half day if lunch morethan 30 minutes and small small break morethan 15 minutes and morethan 1 break.
  • Company will not bear any loss of any company issued items, the equivalent amount will be deducted from the respective month of salary.
  • If company issued some items laptop / mobile/ sim / cables / tools / Pen drive / Led/ keyboard/mouse/devices/ books/head phone / Any cables and cargers any sort of material anything, need to be return after use kindly maintain it properly some damaged and loss deduct from salary, based on amount of that item.
  • Yearly Holidays- 26th January/Holi/15 August/2 October/2 Days Diwali/ Eid-ul-fitr / Eid-ul-zuha
  • Total annual leaves are 18 (manage maximum 1.5 leaves in a month) no carry forward for next year, applicable only after 6 months of joining.
  • Never disrespect any person, Most important clients/customers feedback and satisfaction.
  • Annual Day is on 31st December every year.
  • 2 Award- best attendance and best performance based on yearly work on DPR.
  • Annual increment will be based on the annual performance and announced on the annual day of the company. Employees who have completed 1 year with organisation are only entitled for this increment.


Sincerely,


Authority Signatory


#Annexure details



﻿Read and Accepted


Dear ##EMPLOYEE_NAME##,

Annexure

Please note that you must submit a copy of your Permanent Account Number (PAN) card on your date of joining at ##COMPANY_NAME##. By acknowledging this document, you undertake that you shall be solely responsible for any consequences arising due to non-submission of your PAN copy and ##COMPANY_NAME## shall not be responsible for the same, in any manner whatsoever.

This offer is subject to your reference check clearance. Your retention in company’s employment will be subject to your continued medical fitness. Company reserves the right to ask you to undergo medical examination as and when considered necessary. 

Working Hours

The work timing are at the sole discretion of the Management and would normally consist of a 200 hours’ work on a month. These are subject to change as per business requirements. Same numbers of work hours are expected even when you are on an assignment abroad, unless communicated otherwise by a ##COMPANY_NAME## entity. Paid Leave

Service Commitment / Employee Bond

However, under ##COMPANY_NAME## disciplinary procedure your services can be terminated without any notice period.

Rotational and Shift Work

Based on business requirements and the nature of your role, you may be required to work rotational or shift-based schedules, including night shifts. Any such change in shift timing shall be communicated to you in advance. During such assignments, you shall continue to be governed by the Company’s working hours policy. Where applicable and in force, the Company’s night shift allowance policy shall apply.

Entire Agreement

This offer letter constitutes the entire, final, and exclusive agreement between you and the Company with respect to the terms of your employment and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous discussions, representations, promises, or agreements, whether written or oral. This agreement has been entered into without reliance on any representation not expressly set forth herein and may be amended only by a written instrument duly executed by an authorized representative of the Company.

Severability

If any provision of this offer letter is held to be illegal, invalid, or unenforceable under applicable law, such provision shall be deemed severable, and the remaining provisions shall continue to be valid, binding, and enforceable to the fullest extent permitted by law.

This offer/appointment is subject to the condition that you indemnify and also certify that all the information (like educational qualifications, work experience, past salary drawn and all other information) supplied by you to ##COMPANY_NAME## to get an employment with ##COMPANY_NAME##, is accurate and nothing has been given untrue. ##COMPANY_NAME## reserves the right to change terms and the conditions of your employment and its policies and procedures at any time.

Please sign a duplicate copy of this letter confirming your acceptance of the above terms and conditions of appointment and return it to us for office records.

We are excited about your decision to join the company and wish you a long successful career with ##COMPANY_NAME##.
